newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-Bank sees no let-up on loan risks.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-Bank sees no let-up on loan risks.

text.p: Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG said on Tuesday it did not see any sign of a let-up on the need for high risk provisions this year but said the favourable trend in interest income should continue.

In its interim report, the Bavarian mortgage-lender reported a 9.4 percent rise in risk provisions for the first six months of 1997, while net interest income fell by 3.1 percent, though the decline slowed from a 7.8 percent drop in the first quarter.
"The extremely high number of company collapses and ongoing difficult situation in property markets do not make it advisable to ease up risk provisions," Hypo-Bank said.
